calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-29-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change and Gender.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.
Petitioners Robert Anthony Tibbs and Annatina Tibbs; father and mother of minor present in court.
Petitioners sworn and examined. Minor: Christopher Tibbs sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.
Physician's declaration on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name and gender were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Christopher Tibbs to Christina Alicia Tibbs. And Gender change from Male to Female.
Order Changing Name and Gender signed in open court.
